metadata.question: Were there fires visible in a 50 mile radius around (latitude: 34.498828, longitude: -112.246886) between June 20, 2017 and June 30, 2017?

data.raw_code: The user is asking: "Were there fires visible in a 50 mile radius around (latitude: 34.498828, longitude: -112.246886) between June 20, 2017 and June 30, 2017?" We need to: 1. Convert 50 miles to meters (1 mile = 1609.34 meters, so 50 miles ≈ 80467 meters) 2. Create a point geometry and buffer it by 80467 meters 3. Use fire detection data - best options are: - MODIS Active Fires (MODIS/006/MCD14DL) - daily - VIIRS Active Fires (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML) - higher resolution 4. Date range: June 20, 2017 to June 30, 2017 (inclusive) 5. We need to check if there are any fire pixels (confidence > 0 or fire mask = fire) in the area 6. For fire detection, we should filter by confidence (maybe medium or high confidence) 7. Output: A (Yes) if any fires detected, B (No) if no fires detected 8. Handle cases C1, C2, C3 as needed Data quality considerations: - Check collection size - if 0, output C1 - Check pixel count after filtering - if 0, output C2 - Check if result is valid (not None/NaN) - else C3 We'll use VIIRS VNP14IMGML as primary since it's higher resolution and available for 2017. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.246886, 34.498828]); // 50 miles in meters (1 mile = 1609.34 meters) const bufferDistance = 50 * 1609.34; const region = point.buffer(bufferDistance); const startDate = '2017-06-20'; const endDate = '2017-06-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try VIIRS Active Fires first let fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); let collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS fire collection size: ${collectionSize}`); // If no VIIRS data, try MODIS as fallback if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("Trying MODIS MCD14DL as fallback..."); fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region); collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS fire collection size: ${collectionSize}`); } // Check for empty collection if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No fire detection data found for the specified date and location."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Count fire pixels // For VIIRS: Use 'FireMask' band (3=fire, 2=background, etc.) // For MODIS: Use 'confidence' band (>0 indicates fire) let fireDetected = false; let totalFirePixels = 0; // Get the list of image IDs to iterate const imageList = fireCollection.toList(collectionSize); for (let i = 0; i < collectionSize; i++) { const image = ee.Image(imageList.get(i)); let fireMask; // Check which collection we're using const bandNames = image.bandNames().getInfo(); if (bandNames.includes('FireMask')) { // VIIRS: FireMask = 3 indicates fire fireMask = image.select('FireMask').eq(3); } else if (bandNames.includes('confidence')) { // MODIS: confidence > 0 indicates fire (30=low, 60=nominal, 90=high) fireMask = image.select('confidence').gt(0); } else if (bandNames.includes('MaxFRP')) { // MODIS MCD14DL: MaxFRP > 0 indicates fire fireMask = image.select('MaxFRP').gt(0); } else { console.log(`Image ${i}: No fire detection band found`); continue; } // Count fire pixels in the region const countResult = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, // Use 1km scale for efficiency maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); const fireCount = countResult.get(fireMask.bandNames().get(0)).getInfo(); if (fireCount !== null && fireCount > 0) { console.log(`Image ${i} (${image.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()}): ${fireCount} fire pixels detected`); totalFirePixels += fireCount; fireDetected = true; } } console.log(`Total fire pixels detected in region: ${totalFirePixels}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (totalFirePixels > 0) { console.log("A"); } else if (totalFirePixels === 0) { console.log("B"); } else { // This would happen if fireCount was null or negative console.log("C3"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE().catch(e => { console.error("Initialization error:", e); console.log("D"); }); ```
